en.headline: Court denies bail to man charged over fatal Tsim Sha Tsui pavement crash
en.dek: Ngai Ho-lam, 38, faces nine charges including dangerous driving causing death after a BMW mounted the pavement on Prat Avenue, killing one and injuring three.
body: A 38-year-old man charged with nine offences over a fatal crash in Tsim Sha Tsui has been denied bail and remanded in custody.

Ngai Ho-lam appeared at Kowloon City Court on Tuesday morning facing charges that include dangerous driving causing death, dangerous driving causing grievous bodily harm, careless driving, failing to stop and report, driving while disqualified, and driving without insurance.

Prosecutors said the incident occurred on Sunday afternoon outside 10 Prat Avenue when a private car mounted the pavement, killing a 53-year-old pedestrian and injuring three others. The case was adjourned to 23 February 2027 for further investigation, with a bail review set for 2 December.
Police earlier arrested the driver after the vehicle also struck a traffic sign and a parked goods vehicle before the collision with pedestrians.

zh.headline: 尖沙咀寶勒巷致命車禍被告申請保釋被拒
zh.dek: 38歲倪浩林面對包括危駕致死等9項控罪，周日寶勒巷私家車衝上行人路造成1死3傷。
body: 一名被控9項罪名的38歲男子，因尖沙咀致命交通意外申請保釋遭拒，還押候審。
倪浩林周二上午於九龍城裁判法院提堂，控罪包括危險駕駛引致他人死亡、危險駕駛引致他人身體嚴重傷害、不小心駕駛、意外後不停車及不報案、在停牌期間駕駛及無第三者保險駕駛等。
控方指事發於周日下午約寶勒巷10號外，私家車衝上行人路，造成53歲行人死亡及另外3人受傷。案件押後至明年2月23日再訊，以便警方進一步調查，保釋覆核定於12月2日。
警方較早時拘捕司機，指車輊在撞上行人前曾撞及交通標誌及停泊貨車。
